name: Maximum Subclass Rank
definition: For a nonempty finite binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, $m(C)$ is the largest rank of a maximum subclass of $C$ on the same positioned ground $X$.
normalization: The maximum subclass uses the same visible coordinate set as $C$; constant visible coordinates are retained.
comments: A singleton gives $m(C)\ge0$. If a maximum parent of $C$ has rank $r$ and $a$ auxiliary coordinates, then $r\le a+m(C)$.
